## Decision record: chat anchor data model

Tracked in [PR #7900](https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/7900), which closes this design issue when merged. The record defines a typed ConversationLink projection: about, anchored-to-part, and derived-from fold from #5872's append-only chat.anchor.v1 events; talk-for remains a separate canonical talk-page binding; and resolved-into edit edges fold from #5874's chat.resolution.v1 events.

Part anchors use revision-bound ranges, stable blocks, or object-native regions with a fragment-safe v1 selector grammar. The record specifies deterministic relocation, warning/confirmation for drift, and current, relocated, drifted, disputed, unresolved, orphaned, tombstoned, and unbound states. It preserves the conversation/event history and hides link/tombstone metadata from anyone who cannot read the target.

The parent boundary note is recorded explicitly on [#5682](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/5682#issuecomment-6730461490): the #5870 record consumes #5872–#5874, keeps detailed mixed-access visibility with #5871, and states the resolved-into result-object boundary rather than silently changing #5874. Existing implementation track: [#6222](https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/6222), still gated; no implementation code is included.
